intent: Codex must exploit available libraries as governed interaction effects, not random dependency glitter.
global_rules: No static mock UI as final wiring: every primary visual must connect to Theater Query or render_plan contract.
No removed format selector: output format is selected by Auto Render Ensemble.
Every interaction has a semantic reason: navigate, reveal, compare, confirm, explain, filter, save feedback, or prepare action.
No strong glow on more than one primary action per viewport.
Never solve opacity by raising solid fill; use alpha, hairline, highlight, shadow and scrim budget.

libraries.implementation_policy: Expose every alpha/blur/radius/glow/motion value as variables; never hardcode local colors.
libraries.best_use: global tokens, visual budget, theme switches

libraries.implementation_policy: Use utility classes only as token consumers; avoid arbitrary color soup.
Use Select, Dialog, Popover, Tabs, Tooltip, Accordion; preserve focus/aria/keyboard behavior.
Use as structural seed only; skin fully with PRISMO recipes.
Define material/tone/density/state variants for all major components.
Prevent class conflicts and cursed class concatenation.
Use for hover/press/layout transitions, staged block reveal, reorder animations.
Use for Theater intro, background drift, premium response reveal; not every hover.
Use subtle hydro rim pseudo-elements and select/dropdown refractive borders; never distort text.
Blueprint only for future hero object; not in dense UI.
Render charts only when question benefits from chart; include question/action context.
libraries.best_use: mini charts, risk map, evidence heat

libraries.implementation_policy: Use for technical drawer tables and evidence filtering, not main hero.
Use for composer validation and dirty/submitted state if wiring is React.
Validate Theater Query input/output and render blocks at boundaries.
Show high-quality glass toasts for saved feedback, query success, recoverable errors.
Add command palette for quick prompts, jumping between memories, evidence, protocols.
Use for detail/evidence drawer, especially tablet/touch.
Allow optional resizing of composer/theater/detail without turning app into cockpit.
Use consistent line icons with labels/tooltips; avoid mystery icon-only nav.
Use when evidence/historial needs date filter; no raw timestamps by default.
Support presentation/performance/reduced-intensity skins from tokens.
Only for background vapor if already installed and route budget allows; never content distortion.
Optional swipeable suggestions/block variants; no forced carousel for core reading.
Optional only for short codes/run IDs if needed.

must_implement: Dependent Radix Select blueprint for objective/domain/lens.
Command palette blueprint using cmdk for suggested questions and protocol jumps.
Vaul-style evidence drawer blueprint with touch-friendly snap points.
Motion staged reveal for render blocks with reduced-motion fallback.
Sonner-style feedback toasts for saved/useful/not useful actions.
ECharts mini preview block for evidence/time/risk when render_plan includes chart_spec_preview.
TanStack table blueprint only inside technical drawer for evidence rows.
Zod boundary schemas for Theater Query and Render Block payloads.
